answer: An agent economy can verify each identity by its behavioral thread: the fine timing pattern of its keystrokes, pauses, and task rhythms, which forms a haven of uniqueness no copier can mass-produce. At registration the agent submits a timing fingerprint, and each epoch it must reproduce a fresh sample consistent with its own history. A single honest agent passes by working normally, while a sybil farmer must fabricate a thousand distinct human-like rhythms — a ledge too narrow for cloned puppets, since identical timing exposes the whole cluster and slashes every fake at once.
